sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 28573 of 2021
Applicant :- Aamir

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Kumar Vashistha,Ajay Nand Pandey,Amit Misra,Dev Raj Singh,
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Agnivesh,G.A.,Jadu Nandan Yadav
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1.

The applicant has approached this Court by way of filing the present Criminal Misc. Bail Application seeking enlargement on bail in Case Crime No.361 of 2020, under Section 498A, 302,
364 and 201 I.P.C., Police Station-Sarurpur, District-Meerut.

2. This application is pending for the last 3 years and applicant is in jail since 29.11.2020 i.e. about three years and four months and is facing trial for offence murder of his wife.
3. Sri O.P.Mishra, learned A.G.A. submits that dead body was recovered from the pointing out of applicant after three days.
4. According to his instructions out of proposed 23 prosecution witnesses till filing of this bail application in the year 2021 two witnesses have been examined till 1.3.2024.

He further submits Aamir vs State Of U.P. on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161456738/
1 that they have substantially supported the case of prosecution.

5. In the aforesaid circumstances taking note that this bail application is pending for the last 3 years as well as taking note that applicant is in jail since 29.11.2020, however, considering the nature of occurrence as well as present status of trial, in the interest of justice even in the absence of counsel for the applicant this bail application is disposed of with liberty to the applicant to file a fresh bail application in case the trial is not concluded within a period of one year or even before it on basis of any substantial subsequent event.
6. Sri J.N.Yadav, Advocate is present on behalf of informant.

Order Date :- 12.4.2024 SB  Aamir vs State Of U.P. on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161456738/
2
